{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of Japanese language ''Best Wishes!'' home video releases}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White|Pocket Monsters Best Wishes!]]'' of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. ==Volume releases== ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White|Pocket Monsters Best Wishes!]]'' was divided into five sets that were released by [[Media Factory]] and [[Shogakukan]] from 2011 to 2014. It contains almost all the [[List of Pokémon the Series: Black & White episodes|144 episodes]] between them, except ''[[BWS01|Dent and Takeshi! Gyarados's Imperial Rage!!]]'' and ''[[BWS02|Iris VS Ibuki! The Road to Become a Dragon Master!!]]'', special episodes aired after the series conclusion, and ''[[BW066|Afro GO! Buffron NO!!]]'', which was [[#Special releases|released separately]]. All the DVDs were released for rental only. ===Pocket Monsters Best Wishes!=== Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! was released by [[Media Factory]] and [[Shogakukan]] from 2011 to 2012.
